facts.fact: The African Legal Factory guide describes loi n°001-2021/AN of 30 March 2021 as the law startups must comply with, setting declaration duties and fines; no date of commencement is given, and the date used is the guide's published date.
facts.system: Loi n°001-2021/AN portant protection des personnes à l'égard du traitement des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: The guide states the CIL, created under the 2021 law, is the control authority that startups must declare processing to and that may issue warnings, formal notices, injunctions and fines; the date used is the guide's published date.
facts.system: Commission de l'Informatique et des Libertés (CIL)
